name: Enthalpy v0.4.20
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.20

## Added

- Automations can review all dates, a past number of days, or the current week.
  You can also limit source content to Daily notes. Run details show the exact
  source period.

## Changed

- Automations with a limited source period use recorded content changes to
  select text from older notes. Empty periods produce a no-updates result.
- Deleting a note closes its tab. Deleting a folder also closes the tabs for
  notes in that folder.

## Fixed

- Repeated automatic saves of unchanged text now succeed without an error or
  an extra history entry. Checks still protect newer file content.
- Background changes refresh notes, tasks, search results, Projects, and Areas
  while preserving open editor drafts.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
